# Hazards

<!-- Generated by `mise run catalog:generate` from examples/catalog/: edit the entries, not this file. -->

What only goes wrong while Blender runs: references that go stale after undo or a reallocation, code that crashes
Blender, a restricted context during registration, and Python threads. Most of these cannot be checked statically;
the entries say why and link Blender's own gotcha pages.
